risk.rationale: No verified findings survive for h.ozturk@aegean.edu. The only suspicious signals were KEV-listed VPN appliance claims, both rejected: vpn-edge-02 firmware 22.7R2.8 already includes the version-checkable KEV fixes, and vpn-edge-01 never carried a sign-in for this account so its KEV status is irrelevant to this account's exposure. No data-quality conflicts exist. With suspicious signals explained away and no confirmed account takeover chain, this is benign rather than contain/monitor/escalate.
